lines.zh: 长锥壳劈开水流，我向前推进。
lines.en: My long cone shell parts the water as I push forward.

lines.zh: 八条腕足划动，海底在身下退去。
lines.en: My arms row, and the seabed slides away beneath me.

lines.zh: 气室调整浮力，我升高了一层。
lines.en: I tune the gas chambers and rise a layer.

lines.zh: 奥陶纪的水更冷，我照样游。
lines.en: The Ordovician sea was colder; I swim on regardless.

lines.zh: 我侧身绕过珊瑚，尾尖没擦到。
lines.en: I tilt past the coral without scraping my tip.

lines.zh: 直线最省力，我的壳就适合这样。
lines.en: Straight is cheapest; my shell is built for it.

lines.zh: 鱼群在前面散开，我穿过缝隙。
lines.en: The fish scatter ahead; I thread the gap.

lines.zh: 水压顶着壳尖，我稳住方向。
lines.en: Pressure bears on my shell tip; I hold my course.

lines.zh: 泥底的影子跟着我，慢慢拉长。
lines.en: My shadow drags along the mud, stretching out.

lines.zh: 我不转弯，绕路太费气室。
lines.en: I don't turn; detours cost me air.

lines.zh: 腕足抓住岩壁，我把身体拉过去。
lines.en: My arms grip the rock and haul me across.

lines.zh: 这壳太长，窄缝我钻不进去。
lines.en: My shell is too long for this narrow gap.

lines.zh: 贴着海底滑行，沙子扬了起来。
lines.en: Skimming the floor, I kick up sand.

lines.zh: 身后拖着水痕，很久才散。
lines.en: My wake trails behind me and lingers.

lines.zh: 我喷一口水，借力往前冲。
lines.en: I squirt a jet of water and surge ahead.

lines.zh: 北美的古海是我的老家，我认流向。
lines.en: The old North American sea was home; I know currents.

lines.zh: 壳身沉重，我一步一步往前挪。
lines.en: The shell is heavy; I shift forward step by step.

lines.zh: 穿过整片海藻，我一次没停。
lines.en: I cross the whole kelp bed without stopping once.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，腕足松松垂着。
lines.en: I hang in the water, arms hanging loose.

lines.zh: 气室里咕一声，深度稳住了。
lines.en: A gurgle in my chambers holds my depth.

lines.zh: 等鱼自己靠近，不动最省力。
lines.en: Waiting for fish to come close saves the most effort.

lines.zh: 壳尖朝下，我慢慢漂着。
lines.en: Tip down, I drift slowly.

lines.zh: 水流过腕足，我在读它的方向。
lines.en: Water runs over my arms; I read its direction.

lines.zh: 没有猎物，我就这样悬着。
lines.en: No prey, so I simply hang here.

lines.zh: 壳口触手轻摆，试试水温。
lines.en: Tentacles at my mouth test the water's warmth.

lines.zh: 远处有鳍在动，我听见了。
lines.en: There are fins moving far off; I hear them.

lines.zh: 沉在海底，我像一块石柱。
lines.en: Settled on the floor, I look like a pillar of stone.

lines.zh: 我不动，鱼就会忘了我。
lines.en: If I stay still, the fish forget me.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我辨了辨来源。
lines.en: There's blood in the water; I sort out the source.

lines.zh: 我的壳上长了几颗藤壶。
lines.en: A few barnacles have settled on my shell.

lines.zh: 呼吸的水从虹管慢慢出去。
lines.en: Breathing water slips slowly from my siphon.

lines.zh: 数着经过的鱼，一条，两条。
lines.en: Counting passing fish: one, two.

lines.zh: 你把影子投到我壳上，我抬头。
lines.en: You cast a shadow on my shell; I look up.

lines.zh: 陆地来客，你身上没有海味。
lines.en: A land walker — you carry no sea smell.

lines.zh: 我转正壳口，正对着你。
lines.en: I swing my shell's mouth square to you.

lines.zh: 你在岸上敲什么，我都听得见。
lines.en: Whatever you're knocking up there, I hear it.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，我认得肉。
lines.en: Don't put your hand in; I know meat.

lines.zh: 我盯住你，腕足都收拢了。
lines.en: I fix on you and my arms draw in.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在水面晃，很好看。
lines.en: Your boots wobble on the surface — fine to watch.

lines.zh: 我抬起壳尖，让你看我多长。
lines.en: I lift my tip so you see how long I am.

lines.zh: 你不是鱼，可你也在动。
lines.en: You're not a fish, but you move too.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边的水里转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once in the water by your feet.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我疼得缩腕。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; I curl my arms in pain.

lines.zh: 我退了两丈，水都搅浑了。
lines.en: I retreat two lengths and muddy the water.

lines.zh: 这伤在壳尖，很麻烦。
lines.en: The wound is at my shell tip — that's trouble.

lines.zh: 我喷出一团墨色的水。
lines.en: I jet out a cloud of ink-dark water.

lines.zh: 腕足断了一根，我数了数。
lines.en: One arm's gone; I count the rest.

lines.zh: 先沉下去，躲开再说。
lines.en: Sink away first, think later.

lines.zh: 壳里的气漏了，我得补。
lines.en: My chambers are leaking; I must patch them.

lines.zh: 很疼，可我还游得动。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still swim.

lines.zh: 我转身，把伤处藏到深处。
lines.en: I turn and hide the wound deep down.

lines.zh: 有鱼味，我立刻转向。
lines.en: Fish smell — I turn at once.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼还没死透，给我。
lines.en: That little fish isn't dead yet. Give it here.

lines.zh: 闻到血腥，我的腕足全张。
lines.en: I smell blood and all my arms spread.

lines.zh: 肉在哪里，我追着味道走。
lines.en: Where is the meat? I follow the scent.

lines.zh: 你把鱼丢下来，我就不追你。
lines.en: Drop the fish and I'll stop chasing you.

lines.zh: 壳往前倾，我忍不住了。
lines.en: My shell tips forward; I can't help it.

lines.zh: 这味道比奥陶纪的还香。
lines.en: This smells better than any Ordovician catch.

lines.zh: 我伸出最长的那对腕足。
lines.en: I reach out my longest pair of arms.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我已经看见了。
lines.en: Don't pull it back — I already saw it.

lines.zh: 围着这味道打转，我停不下。
lines.en: I circle the smell and can't stop.

lines.zh: 壳撞上你，我退了半尺。
lines.en: My shell bumps you; I back off half a pace.

lines.zh: 对不起，我这壳实在太长。
lines.en: Sorry — this shell is far too long.

lines.zh: 你挡在我和鱼之间了。
lines.en: You're standing between me and the fish.

lines.zh: 咔一声，壳口磕到了你。
lines.en: A clack — my shell's mouth knocks you.

lines.zh: 我挤过去，水都被推开了。
lines.en: I squeeze past and shove the water aside.

lines.zh: 别站在我壳尖正前方。
lines.en: Don't stand right in front of my shell tip.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我自己都晃。
lines.en: That knock rocked even me.

lines.zh: 收腕收慢了，撞上了。
lines.en: I pulled my arms in too late and hit you.

lines.zh: 壳不是软东西，你该让开。
lines.en: A shell is not soft; you should move aside.

lines.zh: 我们一起卡在这道缝里了。
lines.en: Now we're both wedged in this gap.

lines.zh: 另一具长壳靠近，我放慢速度。
lines.en: Another long shell nears; I slow down.

lines.zh: 我们的壳并排，像两根石柱。
lines.en: Our shells side by side, like two pillars.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，腕足轻轻碰。
lines.en: I circle her and our arms brush.

lines.zh: 奥陶纪的春天，水也是这个温度。
lines.en: Ordovician spring water felt just like this.

lines.zh: 她的壳尖朝我，我知道意思。
lines.en: Her tip points at me; I understand.

lines.zh: 气室排空，我沉下去陪她。
lines.en: I vent my chambers and sink to join her.

lines.zh: 两具壳缠在一起，谁都不动。
lines.en: Two shells twined; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 这一季的海底很安静。
lines.en: The seafloor is quiet this season.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰她的触手，她没躲。
lines.en: I touch her tentacles and she doesn't flinch.

lines.zh: 长壳相遇不多，我记住了。
lines.en: Long shells seldom meet; I'll remember this.

lines.zh: 我用腕足卷起那条鱼。
lines.en: I curl an arm around the fish.

lines.zh: 这块骨头能垫壳口，我要了。
lines.en: This bone will cushion my mouth; it's mine.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进腕足之间。
lines.en: I tuck the thing between my arms.

lines.zh: 掉下来的肉，我接住了。
lines.en: The falling meat — I caught it.

lines.zh: 拾起来看了看，又觉得没用。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and decide it's useless.

lines.zh: 腕足不够用，我只得用壳顶。
lines.en: No free arms, so I balance it on my shell.

lines.zh: 这枚贝壳不错，我收下了。
lines.en: A fine shell — I'll keep this one.

lines.zh: 我把鱼骨叼在壳口。
lines.en: I hold the fish bone at my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 谁掉的，现在归我了。
lines.en: Whose was this? It's mine now.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游进了我的范围。
lines.en: That fish just swam into my reach.

lines.zh: 锁定它，腕足开始蓄力。
lines.en: Locked on; my arms coil.

lines.zh: 影子一停，我就知道是猎物。
lines.en: The shadow stopped; that means prey.

lines.zh: 我调整壳口角度，准备冲。
lines.en: I angle my shell's mouth and prepare to lunge.

lines.zh: 腕足已经卷成筒了。
lines.en: My tentacles have curled into a funnel.

lines.zh: 闻到它的血，目标确认。
lines.en: I smell its blood; target confirmed.

lines.zh: 它转身了，我提前截住。
lines.en: It turned — I cut it off early.

lines.zh: 我要让它撞进我的腕足里。
lines.en: I'll make it swim into my arms.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我收壳。
lines.en: Close enough; I draw in.

lines.zh: 现在我只看它一个。
lines.en: Now I see only it.

lines.zh: 它往左，我的壳就偏左。
lines.en: It goes left; my shell leans left.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流压过去。
lines.en: I press after it with the current.

lines.zh: 它很快，可它游的是直线。
lines.en: It's fast, but it swims straight.

lines.zh: 壳口一直对着它转。
lines.en: My shell's mouth keeps turning on it.

lines.zh: 它躲进珊瑚，我就等。
lines.en: It hides in the coral; I wait.

lines.zh: 腕足已经张成一张网。
lines.en: My arms are already spread like a net.

lines.zh: 它开始累了，我还没累。
lines.en: It's tiring; I'm not.

lines.zh: 一寸一寸，我缩短距离。
lines.en: Inch by inch I close the distance.

lines.zh: 它的鳍乱了，我看得清。
lines.en: Its fins are flapping wrong; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我不急，壳里还有气。
lines.en: No rush — my shell still holds air.

lines.zh: 腕足一夹，鱼就碎了。
lines.en: My arms clamp and the fish bursts.

lines.zh: 我用壳尖直撞过去。
lines.en: I drive my shell tip straight into it.

lines.zh: 触手缠住它，往里拖。
lines.en: Tentacles wrap it and drag it in.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，海水都红了。
lines.en: One bite and the water turns red.

lines.zh: 我砸下去，泥沙飞起来。
lines.en: I slam down and silt flies up.

lines.zh: 我把猎物卷到壳口。
lines.en: I roll the catch to my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 这一击是奥陶纪教我的。
lines.en: The Ordovician taught me this strike.

lines.zh: 腕足收紧，骨头响了。
lines.en: My arms tighten and bones crack.

lines.zh: 咬住不放，直到它软了。
lines.en: I hold the bite until it goes limp.

lines.zh: 水层变冷，我从深处升起。
lines.en: The water cools; I rise from below.

lines.zh: 壳先破开水面，然后是腕足。
lines.en: The shell breaks the surface first, then the arms.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，满口都是咸的。
lines.en: I open my eyes for the first time to salt.

lines.zh: 这片海陌生，水流我却认得。
lines.en: This sea is strange, but I know the current.

lines.zh: 我从岩层里拱出来，壳上挂泥。
lines.en: I push up through rock, mud clinging to my shell.

lines.zh: 远处有鱼群，我先数了数。
lines.en: There's a school far off; I count it first.

lines.zh: 长壳把水搅开一道痕。
lines.en: My long shell cuts a seam through the water.

lines.zh: 醒来时四周只有气泡。
lines.en: When I woke there were only bubbles around me.

lines.zh: 摆正壳口，我试了试水。
lines.en: I straighten my shell's mouth and test the water.

lines.zh: 北美的海不在这里，我记住了。
lines.en: The North American sea isn't here; noted.

lines.zh: 慢慢上浮，我看清这片海域。
lines.en: Rising slowly, I take in this stretch of sea.

lines.zh: 腕足第一次碰到沙，我停了一下。
lines.en: My arms first touch sand and I pause.

lines.zh: 水里的火也烫到我的壳。
lines.en: Even underwater, fire scalds my shell.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛出，砸在石上。
lines.en: I was thrown from the water onto stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳口，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water floods my shell's mouth; I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把我整具壳掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips my whole shell over.

lines.zh: 一根尖刺钉进了壳缝。
lines.en: A spike lodges in the seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 壳里有东西在烧，不是水。
lines.en: Something burns inside my shell, and it isn't water.

lines.zh: 鱼越来越少了，我饿得慢下来。
lines.en: Fewer fish now; hunger is slowing me.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿壳走遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my wet shell and through me.

lines.zh: 海底没有了，我在往下掉。
lines.en: The seabed is gone; I'm falling.
